facts.text: I am trying to get more organized.
I want recommendations for apps or tools to keep track of my cleaning schedule and tasks.
I am thinking of using Habitica.
I have been doing a daily 30-minute cleaning routine for about 3 weeks.
My daily 30-minute cleaning routine has been making a huge difference in my productivity and energy levels.
I am thinking of creating a custom habit in Habitica for my "one-touch rule".
I want to track my "one-touch rule" habit in Habitica.
I plan to apply the one-touch rule to simple tasks like putting away dirty dishes immediately after meals.
I plan to apply the one-touch rule to responding to simple emails as soon as I read them.
I have been meaning to organize my digital files and documents.
I plan to handle each file or document once and either delete, file, or take action on it immediately.
I plan to use Habitica's rewards system to track my progress and stay motivated.
I plan to set up a reward for myself when I complete a certain number of days or tasks successfully following the one-touch rule.
I want to treat myself to a favorite meal or activity when I reach a milestone.
I like the idea of creating a "Someday" folder to keep track of things that don't require immediate attention but might be useful in the future.
I plan to track my daily cleaning routine in Habitica in addition to the one-touch rule.
I have been doing my daily cleaning routine for 3 weeks.
I want to decide whether to set up a habit for each specific cleaning task like "make bed" and "wipe down kitchen counters" or a general "daily cleaning" habit.
